# Manage IT Digital Ltd (ManageIT)

> Manage IT Digital is an IT services company in Christchurch, New Zealand,
> founded in 2004 by Tony Condon. We provide managed IT support, cloud
> backups, cloud migration, and endpoint management for small and medium
> businesses across New Zealand, with a focus on clear communication and
> personalised local service.

Contact: Unit 1/27A Sir William Pickering Drive, Burnside, Christchurch 8053.
Phone 03 381 0333 or 0800 648 787. Email info@manageit.nz.
Hours: Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm NZT, with emergency support available.

## Pages

- [Home](https://manageit.nz/): Overview of our IT solutions and computer
  networking services for New Zealand businesses.
- [IT Support](https://manageit.nz/services/it-support): Remote and on-site
  IT support - password resets, virus removal, proactive monitoring, and
  regular maintenance.
- [Cloud Backups](https://manageit.nz/services/cloud-backup): Daily backups
  for Microsoft 365, Google Workplace and business data, with recoverability
  testing and disaster recovery planning.
- [Cloud Migration](https://manageit.nz/services/cloud-migration): Planning
  and execution of moves to cloud infrastructure, with security and
  business-continuity focus.
- [Endpoint Management](https://manageit.nz/services/endpoint-management):
  Remote monitoring and management of business devices, patching, and
  proactive device support.
- [About Us](https://manageit.nz/about-us): Company history, values, and the
  team - 20+ years serving 100+ New Zealand businesses.
- [Contact](https://manageit.nz/contact): Contact form, phone numbers, office
  location and map.

## Client portal

Existing clients access remote support (NinjaOne), ticket management, and
Microsoft 365 tools via the Portal button on any page of the site.
